summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with quarterly financial statements and MD&A for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine interim report by a Canadian foreign private issuer, containing condensed consolidated financial statements, certifications, and operational updates. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The report shows a net earnings of $64.9M for the quarter, compared to a net loss in the prior year, but this is normal operating performance and does not constitute a special situation.
